# Trace

> > Trace is an AI-powered sports camera platform that automatically captures, analyzes, and edits soccer game footage for players, families, and academies.

Trace combines hardware (TraceCam) and software (PlayerFocus Analytics, AI Reels) to deliver automated game recording, player tracking, performance metrics, and highlight generation. The platform serves youth soccer players, families, and academies looking to document and analyze game performance.

## Key Topics

- TraceCam
- PlayerFocus Analytics
- PlayerCam
- AI Reels
- MultiCam
- Player Tracking
- Highlights Generation
- Sports Analytics
- AI Video Editing
- Game Recording
- Youth Soccer
- Coaching Tool
- Video Sharing
- Performance Metrics
- Automated Editing

## Features & Analytics

- [PlayerFocus Analytics](https://traceup.com/product-features/playerfocus-analytics): PlayerFocus Analytics platform for soccer performance metrics and stats
- [PlayerCam](https://traceup.com/product-features/playercam): PlayerCam feature automatically centers player in action footage
- [MultiCam](https://traceup.com/product-features/multicam): MultiCam feature for multi-angle recording and synchronized video capture
- [AI Reels](https://traceup.com/product-features/ai-reels): AI Reels feature for automated highlight video generation and editing
